collection.description: The collection (an index on Pinecone, a class on Weaviate). vector_list_collections lists them.

namespace.description: Pinecone: the namespace (empty: the default one). Weaviate: the tenant of a multi-tenant collection. Milvus: the partition. Not used by Qdrant and Chroma.

vector.description: Search near this vector; its length is the collection's dimension.

id.description: Search near the stored record with this id.

text.description: Search by text where the store embeds or matches it itself: Pinecone's indexes with integrated embedding, Weaviate (with a vectorizer for semantic; keyword and hybrid with BM25), Milvus collections with a text function. Qdrant and Chroma need vector or id.

textMode.description: With text: semantic (embeddings), keyword (BM25) or hybrid (both, Weaviate).

filter.description: Records whose metadata match, in MongoDB's form: {"genre": "drama", "year": {"$gte": 2020}}. Operators $eq $ne $gt $gte $lt $lte $in $nin $exists, and $and / $or with a list. The store evaluates it; a field it doesn't index may be refused.

vectorName.description: Which vector of a collection with several named vectors (Qdrant, Weaviate) or vector fields (Milvus).

includeVectors.description: Also return each record's vector values.
